highlights: The company continues to target a long-term debt-to-capital ratio of approximately 40.0% by year-end. • The company repurchased $5.0 billion of its common stock and paid $6.2 billion in dividends year-to-date.

UnitedHealthcare served 48.3 million people in the third quarter 2026. • UnitedHealthcare’s third quarter 2026 earnings from operations were $2.8 billion and operating margin was 3.3% compared to $1.8 billion and 2.1% in the third quarter 2025.

UnitedHealthcare Employer & Individual • UnitedHealthcare Employer & Individual third quarter 2026 revenues were $20.2 billion compared to $19.9 billion in the third quarter 2025. • The number of people served contracted by 165,000 in the third quarter 2026 due to employer attrition.

5 UnitedHealthcare Community & State • UnitedHealthcare Community & State third quarter 2026 revenues were $23.7 billion compared to $23.8 billion in the third quarter 2025. • People served contracted by 85,000 in the third quarter 2026 due to ongoing Medicaid eligibility changes.

Optum and consolidated revenues for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 include Optum eliminations of $4,152 and $3,546; and corporate eliminations of $118,460 and $123,725, respectively.

quotes.text: Our third quarter results reflect the discipline and execution our teams are bringing to every part of our business, as we continue evolving UnitedHealth Group to deliver a simpler, more supportive experience for patients and the clinicians who care for them.
quotes.by: Stephen Hemsley, chief executive officer of UnitedHealth Group
